task: Issue #4 outstanding item G0-3: office artifact acceptance lacked complete rubrics and an approval flow (Word layout / PPT visual / Excel formula rubric; quality-acceptance route was coverage=partial with only verification-before-completion principles)

deliverable.machine_checks: workflow-validate PASS — schema shape, DAG acyclicity + reachability, stage-IO closure, tool references ('none' — pure method contract), providers are registered skills, approval points registered
deliverable.rubric: per-artifact-type checkable criteria in step validators: docx (heading style hierarchy, refreshable TOC, numbering continuity, no page-breaking table headers), pptx (master/layout adherence, slide count within brief bounds, contrast, no overflowing text boxes), xlsx (typed cells, no #REF!/#VALUE! errors, frozen header row, number format/unit consistency), pdf (embedded fonts, uniform page size, bookmarks for long documents); every review-stage step carries a concrete validator — no vague pass
deliverable.approval_flow: acceptance-verdict (accept / reject / accept-with-conditions, human approver, four sub-reports attached) + handoff (only accepted artifacts delivered with rubric attached; rejected stay drafts with reasons)
deliverable.honesty_rules: placeholder text counts as not-delivered; number mismatches are flagged, not silently trusted; unverifiable compliance items are recorded unknown with the tool needed, never silently passed; rubric conflicts with the brief are dual-recorded for the approver
deliverable.failure_paths: cancel (partial results retained, marked unfinished), missing_dependency (no brief / unparseable artifact -> refuse to score), rubric_conflict (dual-recorded, approver decides)

red_first: asset-manager/tests/office-acceptance.test.mjs failed on main before the contract existed (assertion: contract must exist), passes after; suite count 169 -> 170
license_note: docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx remain restricted-declared; the contract routes to them as method providers only and states this in notes — no view/deploy/activation gate is weakened by this deliverable
not_claimed: This is a method-and-routing contract, not an automated scoring agent; it does not execute file access by itself, does not unblock restricted assets, and does not claim coverage of professional typesetting certification beyond the listed rubric items
